svg.title: How to drive the simulations · Cosmic Library
svg.desc: How to drive the simulations, in four animated panels. Drag: a mouse cursor drags across a banded planet and spins it, to look around. Scroll or pinch: a mouse wheel zooms in on the Moon, then two fingertips pinch together and it shrinks back. Click or tap: a hand taps Saturn, a ripple spreads and an info card pops up with its name. Press the question-mark key: it presses down and a help panel slides in with Controls, Tips and a Low graphics switch that turns on.
